issues.duplicateEdge: Connection {{source}} -> {{target}} already exists ({{edgeId}}). Edit the existing edge instead of adding a second one.
issues.fanInRequiresJunction: "{{label}}" has several incoming connections. Add a junction in front of it.
issues.noTrigger: The workflow has no trigger. Without a trigger node (manual, schedule, webhook, …) there is no entry point, so the engine runs nothing.
issues.isolatedNode: "{{label}}" is not connected to the graph: it has neither incoming nor outgoing edges.
issues.orphanRoot: "{{label}}" has no incoming connection and is not a trigger, so it is skipped when the workflow runs.
issues.unreachableNode: "{{label}}" cannot be reached from any trigger: the path to it runs through disabled edges or a cycle.
issues.dupOutputVariable: outputVariable "{{name}}" is already set by another step, so downstream references {{reference}} hit either of the two at random.
issues.dupPublishedParam: Two activities publish "{{name}}". The unqualified form {{shortForm}} is not bound, because a published value has exactly one owner. Reference it as {{qualified}}.
issues.unknownTemplateRef: "{{label}}" references {{reference}}, but that step does not exist (or has a different name). Typo, or was the outputVariable renamed?
issues.missingTargetMachine: "{{label}}": remote activities need a target machine (targetMachineId).
issues.startJobInRunspace: "{{label}}": the script calls {{cmdlet}}, which starts a background job (Start-Job) internally and needs an external pwsh.exe. The in-process runspace (engine: "{{engine}}") does not support that. Set engine: "pwsh" in the activity config.
issues.unknownWorkflowRef: "{{label}}": workflow "{{reference}}" not found. Typo, or was it deleted?
issues.edgeToDisabled: This edge points at a disabled step, which never runs.
issues.disabledWithDownstream: "{{label}}" is disabled but still has outgoing connections, so the steps after it are skipped too. Remove the edges or enable the step again.
issues.edgeOccluded: The edge runs through {{nodes}}. It looks unconnected, but the engine still runs it. Use Auto-Layout (Tidy) to clean up the layout.
issues.edgeCrowded: The edge runs close past {{nodes}}, which makes it hard to follow even though the connection exists. Auto-Layout (Tidy) spaces the nodes more clearly.
issues.triggerWithoutOutgoing: Trigger "{{label}}" has no outgoing connection: it fires, but nothing runs after it.
issues.noDescription: The workflow has no description. A short line helps colleagues see in the workflow list what it does.
